editorial.titleTr: The middle power alliance called 'delusion' is what we need more than ever
summaryTr: The U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense criticized middle-power alliances as a delusion.
South Korea should pursue middle-power cooperation through pragmatic diplomacy.
Securing strategic autonomy is key to protecting national interests.
editorial.bodyTr: Elbridge Colby, U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense for Policy, criticized the concept of middle power alliances as a delusion and emphasized America-centric alliances. South Korea must pursue pragmatic diplomacy to secure cooperation among middle powers and strategic autonomy in order to protect national interests.

summaryTr: Government announces plan to supply 230,000 housing units in Seoul metropolitan area, but effectiveness in question
Strong tax measures to begin next year, housing construction to commence after 2030
Concerns over listing freeze due to time gap between tax implementation and housing supply
editorial.bodyTr: The government's announced housing supply plan of 230,000 units in the Seoul metropolitan area presents both key provisions and significant problems worthy of analysis. editorials.titleTr: [Editorial] Special Prosecutor's Overreach: Dragging in Shin Won-sik's Martial Law Opposition and Jung Jin-seok on Unrelated Charges
summaryTr: The second special prosecutor indicted Shin Won-sik and Jung Jin-seok, who opposed martial law.
The investigation was forcibly pursued through arbitrary interpretation of when the rebellion ended.
We criticize the special prosecutor's abuse of power lacking judicial legitimacy.
editorials.bodyTr: The second special prosecution indicted former National Security Advisor Shin Won-sik and former Presidential Chief of Staff Jung Jin-seok on charges related to martial law. Unlike the first special prosecution, it arbitrarily interprets when the rebellion ended and recklessly investigates former government officials while disregarding established legal principles. This editorial strongly criticizes the special prosecution's conduct and raises questions about its judicial legitimacy.

editorials.titleTr: Editorial: Democratic Party's Legislative Overreach Bears Fruit as 529 Judges Indicted on 'Judicial Distortion' Charges
summaryTr: Since the introduction of the 'law distortion crime,' thousands of people, including 529 judges, have been reported.
Reports against judicial and investigative authorities are being abused in a serious manner.
Reduced law enforcement and wasted investigative resources are intensifying social chaos.
editorials.bodyTr: Since the introduction of the law distortion charge, 529 judges, 727 prosecutors, and 3,535 police officers have been indicted, indicating rampant abuse of prosecutions targeting judicial and investigative authorities. Critics point out that this is resulting in a chilling effect on law enforcement, wasting investigative resources, and causing social confusion.

[연합뉴스] 극한 가뭄에 시달리는 경남 지역에 내린 국가소방동원령에 따라 전국의 소방차 200여 대가 최근 현지에 급파됐고, 육해공군 병력도 투입하기로 했다. ‘마른장마’로 인해 장기간 비가 내리지 않고 40도 넘는 폭염이 이어지면서 농업용 저수지가 마르고 식수를 제한급수하고 있다. 지난해엔 영동, 2022년엔 호남, 올해엔 영남을 강타한 기후재난이 내년에는 어디를 노릴지 예측조차 하기 어렵다. 기후 위기에 따른 재난이 갈수록 빈번하고 피해가 커짐에 따라 이제 극한 가뭄과 물난리를 상수로 놓고 국가 차원에서 과감하고 적극적인 물 관리 전략을 짜야 한다. 무엇보다 물 관리 인프라 확충이 시급하다. 특히 반도체 메가프로젝트가 추진되는 광주특별시 일대는 용수 부족 사태가 우려되는 만큼 특단의 물그릇 확보 대책이 필요하다. 이번 영남 가뭄은 20년 빈도라는데 한국농어촌공사가 관리하는 전국 3422개 저수지의 99.6%가 10년 빈도 이하의 보통 가뭄을 예상하고 설계됐다. 20년 이상 빈도의 ‘독한 가뭄’에도 견딜 수 있도록 대폭 보강해야 한다. 유엔이 지구온난화와 기후 위기의 위험성을 경고한 공식 보고서를 처음 발표한 것은 1990년이지만, 대한민국의 대응은 느리고 일관성도 떨어진다. 특히 폭염·가뭄·홍수에 대비한 계획은 정권의 이념 성향에 따라 오락가락해 왔다. 예컨대 이명박 정부는 2012년 14개 댐 건설 후보지가 포함된 ‘댐 건설 장기계획(2012~2021년)을 마련했지만, 2018년 문재인 정부가 중단시켰다. 윤석열 정부가 기후대응댐 14개 신설을 추진했으나 7개를 이재명 정부가 지난해 9월 취소했다. 호남 반도체 공장 신설에 따른 용수 확보 우려가 제기되자 뒤늦게 신규 댐 건설 카드를 검토하겠다니 만시지탄이다. 댐 신설은 후보지 선정, 토지 보상, 건설(6~7년)을 포함해 10~20년이 걸리는 장기 프로젝트다. 적어도 2012년에 댐 건설을 계획대로 추진했다면 지금의 물 부족 사태는 완화할 수 있었을 것이다. 정부는 이제라도 환경근본주의에서 탈피해 신규 댐 건설, 상수도 정비, 하수 재이용, 해수 담수화, 지하수 활용 등 실용적인 물 관리 전략을 마련해야 한다.

editorial.titleTr: [Editorial] Water Resource Strategy Becomes Urgent Priority as Extreme Droughts Become the New Normal
summaryTr: As severe droughts become commonplace, water management has emerged as a national emergency priority.
99.6% of reservoirs nationwide are unprepared for droughts that occur once every 20 years.
Dam policy has wavered with each change of administration; a pragmatic strategy is now essential.
editorial.bodyTr: Minister Kim Sung-hwan of the Climate, Energy and Environment Ministry testified before the National Assembly's Committee on Climate, Energy, Environment and Labor on the 11th. Following a national fire mobilization order for the severe drought gripping the Gyeongnam region, some 200 fire trucks from across the country were recently dispatched to the area, and military personnel from the Army, Navy and Air Force have been mobilized as well. With the "dry monsoon" bringing prolonged absence of rain and scorching heat exceeding 40 degrees Celsius, agricultural reservoirs have dried up and drinking water is being rationed. Climate disasters struck Yeongdong last year, Honam in 2022, and Yeongnam this year, making it difficult to even predict which region will be hit next year. As climate-related disasters become increasingly frequent and damages grow larger, the nation must now establish bold and proactive water management strategies with extreme droughts and floods treated as constants. Above all, expansion of water management infrastructure is urgently needed. In particular, the Gwangju Special City area where semiconductor megaprojects are underway requires extraordinary measures to secure additional water resources due to concerns over water shortages. This drought in Yeongnam is said to have a 20-year recurrence interval, yet 99.6 percent of the 3,422 reservoirs managed by the Korea Rural Community Corporation were designed and constructed based on expectations of ordinary droughts with recurrence intervals of 10 years or less. These reservoirs must be substantially reinforced to withstand "severe droughts" with recurrence intervals of 20 years or more. Though the United Nations first released an official report warning of the dangers of global warming and climate crisis in 1990, South Korea's response has been slow and inconsistent. In particular, plans for extreme heat, droughts and flooding have wavered depending on the ideological orientation of each administration. For example, the Lee Myung-bak government prepared a "Long-term Dam Construction Plan (2012-2021)" that included 14 potential dam construction sites in 2012, but the Moon Jae-in government halted it in 2018. The Yoon Suk-yeol government pursued the construction of 14 new climate response dams, but the Lee Jae-myung government canceled seven of them last September. When concerns were raised about water procurement for the new semiconductor plant in Honam, the government belatedly began reviewing the option of constructing new dams—a case of too little, too late. Dam construction is a long-term project that takes 10 to 20 years, including site selection, land compensation, and construction spanning six to seven years. Had the government proceeded with dam construction as planned starting in 2012, the current water shortage crisis could have been significantly alleviated. The government must now abandon environmental fundamentalism and establish practical water management strategies including new dam construction, water supply system upgrades, wastewater reuse, seawater desalination, and groundwater utilization.

editorial.title: Dangerous mismatch
editorial.body: North Korea gains battlefield experience as South Korea-US allies scale back drills South Korea and the United States have scaled back field training exercises (FTX) during the Ulchi Freedom Shield, a combined military exercise, compared with last year. Meanwhile, North Korea, which is accelerating its nuclear threat, is gaining real-world combat experience by deploying troops to Russia to fight in the war against Ukraine. This year's UFS also provides an opportunity to assess South Korea's ability to lead the combined forces after assuming wartime operational control from the United States. At a time when South Korea and the US should be further strengthening their combined defense capabilities, the two allies are instead curtailing military exercises and pushing ahead with the transfer of wartime OPCON, leaving the public understandably concerned about national security. The allies will conduct 14 field training exercises, down from 22 last year, during the UFS scheduled for Aug. 17-27. Likewise, during the Freedom Shield exercise in March, the allies reduced field training exercises from last year’s 51 to 22 after differences emerged between South Korea and the US. According to reports, South Korean military authorities abruptly requested the US military cancel all combined field training exercises, and the two sides failed to agree on the number of exercises until the Freedom Shield details were announced. Field training exercises involve moving actual troops and equipment to execute operational plans. Only when FTXs are integrated into the UFS can the allies meaningfully assess their combined defense posture. The Lee Jae Myung administration plans to set a target year for the wartime OPCON transfer at the Security Consultative Meeting in November. But the proper order is to determine the timing of the transfer after the necessary military capabilities and conditions have been met. When strengthening the South Korea-US combined defense posture is more urgent than ever, it is hardly justified to reduce military exercises while rushing the transfer of wartime OPCON. When it comes to national security, most South Koreans believe that the combined defense capabilities of the two allies are more essential to the nation's survival than anything else. Retaking wartime operational control may be a matter of national pride for South Koreans, but more important is a matter of survival. This is why the combined defense capabilities must be further strengthened regardless of the OPCON transition. In July, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Russia wanted an additional 30,000 North Korean troops and that discussions were underway. North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui met with Russian President Vladimir Putin, and they may have discussed an additional troop deployment and a visit by North Korean leader Kim Jong-un to Russia. The deployment of North Korean troops to Russia in 2024 became a reality shortly after Zelenskyy revealed that preparations were in progress. If a military with no combat experience has to face one with real-world combat experience, it must train more frequently and under conditions as close to actual combat as possible. A military that seeks to avoid training has no chance of winning. If North Korea receives advanced military technology from Russia in return for deploying troops, it could pose an entirely new level of threat to South Korea's security. What is the state of the South Korean military's readiness? Military discipline has recently deteriorated to an unacceptable level, with the media exposing frontline units where soldiers stood guard with unloaded rifles on the arbitrary orders of a corps commander. The incident in which South Korean forces nearly shot down a US drone during a training exercise highlights gaps in South Korea-US coordination. To make matters worse, diplomatic friction is already emerging between Seoul and Washington over the controversies surrounding Coupang and South Korea’s Information and Communications Network Act. When South Korea and the US should be strengthening their combined defense posture, they are instead moving in the opposite direction, raising serious public concern that their military alliance may itself be weakening. summaryTr: 남한과 미국이 군사훈련을 36% 축소하는 동안 북한은 우크라이나에서 전투경험을 쌓고 있다.
군사능력 미달과 조율 부족에도 불구하고 전시 작전통제권 전환 추진
전문가, 전투경험 풍부한 북한을 상대로 훈련 축소는 국가안보 위험이라 경고
editorial.bodyTr:
북한이 전장 경험 쌓는 가운데 한미 연합훈련 축소

한국과 미국이 한미연합훈련인 을지프리덤실드 기간 야외기동훈련(FTX)을 지난해보다 축소했다. 한편 핵위협을 가속화하는 북한은 우크라이나전에 참전하기 위해 러시아에 군대를 파병함으로써 실전 전투 경험을 쌓고 있다. 올해 을지프리덤실드는 미국으로부터 전시작전통제권을 넘겨받은 뒤 한국이 연합군을 주도할 능력을 평가할 수 있는 기회를 제공한다. 한국과 미국이 연합방위 능력을 더욱 강화해야 할 시점인데도 두 동맹국이 군사훈련을 축소하고 전시작전통제권 이양을 추진하면서 국민들이 국방안보에 대해 우려하는 것은 당연하다.

8월 17~27일 예정된 을지프리덤실드 기간 한미는 지난해 22개에서 14개로 야외기동훈련을 감축한다. 마찬가지로 3월 프리덤실드 훈련 때도 한미 간 이견이 생기자 지난해 51개에서 22개로 야외기동훈련을 줄였다. 언론보도에 따르면 한국 군당국이 미군에 연합 야외기동훈련 전면 취소를 요청했고, 두 나라가 훈련 규모에 합의하지 못해 프리덤실드 세부사항이 공표될 때까지 갈등했다. 야외기동훈련은 실제 부대와 장비를 움직여 작전계획을 실행하는 것이다. 야외기동훈련이 을지프리덤실드에 통합되어야만 연합방위태세를 의미 있게 평가할 수 있다.

이재명 정부는 11월 국방장관 회담에서 전시작전통제권 이양의 목표 시한을 정할 계획이다. 그러나 올바른 순서는 필요한 군사 능력과 여건이 충족된 후 이양 시기를 결정하는 것이다. 한미 연합방위태세 강화가 그 어느 때보다 중요한 시점에 군사훈련을 줄이면서 전시작전통제권 이양을 성급히 추진하는 것은 정당화되기 어렵다.

국방안보와 관련해서는 대다수 한국인이 국가 생존을 위해 한미 양국의 연합방위 능력이 다른 무엇보다 본질적이라고 생각한다. 전시작전통제권 회수가 한국인에게는 국가적 자존심의 문제일 수 있지만, 더 중요한 것은 생존의 문제다. 이것이 바로 전시작전통제권 이양과 관계없이 연합방위 능력을 더욱 강화해야 하는 이유다.

전투 경험이 없는 군대가 실전 경험이 있는 군대와 맞서야 한다면, 더욱 자주 그리고 실전에 가까운 조건에서 훈련해야 한다. 훈련을 피하려 하는 군대는 승리할 가능성이 없다. 만약 북한이 파병의 대가로 러시아로부터 첨단 군사기술을 제공받는다면, 이는 한국의 안보에 전혀 새로운 수준의 위협이 될 수 있다.

editorials.title: Dangerous mismatch
editorials.body: North Korea gains battlefield experience as South Korea-US allies scale back drills South Korea and the United States have scaled back field training exercises (FTX) during the Ulchi Freedom Shield, a combined military exercise, compared with last year. Meanwhile, North Korea, which is accelerating its nuclear threat, is gaining real-world combat experience by deploying troops to Russia to fight in the war against Ukraine. This year's UFS also provides an opportunity to assess South Korea's ability to lead the combined forces after assuming wartime operational control from the United States. At a time when South Korea and the US should be further strengthening their combined defense capabilities, the two allies are instead curtailing military exercises and pushing ahead with the transfer of wartime OPCON, leaving the public understandably concerned about national security. The allies will conduct 14 field training exercises, down from 22 last year, during the UFS scheduled for Aug. 17-27. Likewise, during the Freedom Shield exercise in March, the allies reduced field training exercises from last year’s 51 to 22 after differences emerged between South Korea and the US. According to reports, South Korean military authorities abruptly requested the US military cancel all combined field training exercises, and the two sides failed to agree on the number of exercises until the Freedom Shield details were announced. Field training exercises involve moving actual troops and equipment to execute operational plans. Only when FTXs are integrated into the UFS can the allies meaningfully assess their combined defense posture. The Lee Jae Myung administration plans to set a target year for the wartime OPCON transfer at the Security Consultative Meeting in November. But the proper order is to determine the timing of the transfer after the necessary military capabilities and conditions have been met. When strengthening the South Korea-US combined defense posture is more urgent than ever, it is hardly justified to reduce military exercises while rushing the transfer of wartime OPCON. When it comes to national security, most South Koreans believe that the combined defense capabilities of the two allies are more essential to the nation's survival than anything else. Retaking wartime operational control may be a matter of national pride for South Koreans, but more important is a matter of survival. This is why the combined defense capabilities must be further strengthened regardless of the OPCON transition. In July, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Russia wanted an additional 30,000 North Korean troops and that discussions were underway. North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui met with Russian President Vladimir Putin, and they may have discussed an additional troop deployment and a visit by North Korean leader Kim Jong-un to Russia. The deployment of North Korean troops to Russia in 2024 became a reality shortly after Zelenskyy revealed that preparations were in progress. If a military with no combat experience has to face one with real-world combat experience, it must train more frequently and under conditions as close to actual combat as possible. A military that seeks to avoid training has no chance of winning. If North Korea receives advanced military technology from Russia in return for deploying troops, it could pose an entirely new level of threat to South Korea's security. What is the state of the South Korean military's readiness? Military discipline has recently deteriorated to an unacceptable level, with the media exposing frontline units where soldiers stood guard with unloaded rifles on the arbitrary orders of a corps commander. The incident in which South Korean forces nearly shot down a US drone during a training exercise highlights gaps in South Korea-US coordination. To make matters worse, diplomatic friction is already emerging between Seoul and Washington over the controversies surrounding Coupang and South Korea’s Information and Communications Network Act. When South Korea and the US should be strengthening their combined defense posture, they are instead moving in the opposite direction, raising serious public concern that their military alliance may itself be weakening. editorials.bodyTr: As the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation approaches, the final calligraphy left by Dr. Ahn Jung-geun in a Lüshun prison has been made public. The eight-character phrase "Mankuk Gongbeop Bulryeo Daeppo" (萬國公法不如大砲), meaning "international law is no match for cannon fire," contains Dr. Ahn's final insight as he awaited execution following the assassination of Ito Hirobumi. Given the grave security situation, including North Korean troops being dispatched to Russia, this historical lesson deserves our serious attention.

What matters as much as the numbers is the actual capacity to implement.
The success of the policy depends on concrete execution.
